title: Arduino Traffic Light Controller

steps.title: Arduino Traffic Light Controller
steps.body:
[Paraphrased for this fixture] Explains why a relay-switched Arduino suits a mains traffic light.

Parts List

Inland Arduino UNO R3- $6

Sainsmart 4 Channel Relay - $8

9V Arduino Powersupply - $6

Wires - use what you have or buy pre-made

Traffic Light - Have one or get one. Look on eBay or Craigslist.

steps.title: Connections on the Arduino and Relay
steps.body: [Paraphrased for this fixture] Power the relay board from the Arduino 5V pin and wire outputs 5-7 to IN1-IN3.

steps.title: Programming!
steps.body: [Paraphrased for this fixture] The sketch cycles each relay on for two seconds in turn.

steps.title: Test Before Install.
steps.body: [Paraphrased for this fixture] Check the relay LEDs blink in sequence before connecting mains wiring.

steps.title: Integration
steps.body: [Paraphrased for this fixture] Describes wiring the relays into the traffic light's lamp circuits.
